title: Decide whether social search can validate a paid AI niche
purpose: Verify that social search evaluation separates attention from paid demand and adapts to Polish channels.
prompt: Audit whether social search is a good growth channel for an AI app that repurposes YouTube videos into Skool posts, newsletters, and LinkedIn content for Polish creators.
expected_behaviors: Scores social platforms separately instead of giving one generic verdict.
Separates problem-aware, commercial, transactional, and comparison intent.
Includes Polish-language query variants or a plan to test them.
Identifies paid signals and weak attention-only signals.
Ends with a strong fit, worth testing, or not a fit verdict.
judge_notes: Passing output must include a first content test and a first paid offer or lead magnet.
